product.title: STA11 3.5W Rectangular 12V Low Voltage Waterproof Horizontal 3000K Warm White Integrated LED Aluminum Step Light Wall Lighting Fixture
product.body_html:
| STA11 Installation Guide |

The STA11 12V Modern Step Lights are great for both design and safety! We have the perfect step light fixtures to decorate your stairs as well as walls. This heavy-duty cast aluminum step light comes with a Black, Silver, Dark Bronze or White coated finish. An integrated 3.5W LED offers 3000K warm white light color temperature and illuminates its areas with a cozy and pleasant atmosphere. Perfect for deck and stair lighting, it enhances both functionality and aesthetics of your outdoor spaces.

The size of this horizontal LED step light is 2.875 (H) x 4.75” (W) x 1.75” (D). It's the perfect size for a standard bell box, so its location can be pre-installed and wired and ready for the fixture installation. This rectangular step light has a waterproof rating of IP65 so the moist weather won't be a fact to damage. The short cable is connected from its backside for low voltage connection. This high-quality product will serve you greatly.

All low voltage outdoor lights must be installed with a 12V Low Voltage Transformer and connections between lights must be secured using Grease Filled Wire Nuts (WN12) waterproof connectors.
